content:
maria: heads up — ran speculative decode + PTQ-4bit on titan-13b in canary, seeing a quality regression on our Q&A evals. latency down ~22% p50 but EM dropped ~3.5pts on dev set.
sam: can you paste the exact config and how spec was configured?
maria: config snapshot:
```
speculative: true
spec_policy:
  fallback_after_ms: 30
  probe_frac: 0.06
quantization: ptq-4bit
batch_size: 8
warm_prefix: true
```
dmitri: @maria which eval sets and were prefixes warm or cold?
maria: evals: SQuAD-like synthetic (1k), code-qa (500). cache warmed for most runs (~2s). Baseline EM=79.2 -> 75.7 with spec+4bit. 4bit without spec is 78.9, so majority of drop seems tied to speculative path.
sam: so 4-bit alone almost fine, spec amplifies the problem. any immediate hypothesis?
maria: my current guess: quantization introduces distributional noise; speculative prefill picks tokens that look high-prob under quantized fast model but are wrong under the main model, and fallback timing doesn't recover.
dmitri: can we run a controlled matrix: (A) baseline float no-spec, (B) 4bit no-spec, (C) 4bit + spec probe_frac=0.01, (D) 4bit + spec fallback_after_ms=10. collect EM, ppl, latency p50/p95. also dump mismatch examples.
maria: starting those tonight. will also export top-k token probs for prefetched tokens.
ops-bot: CI queued: run-ml-eval/1716812345-spec-decode-triage (3 experiments). ETA ~6h.
sam: can we pin canary to 0% until triage? want to stop further exposure.
ops-bot: Canary for route /gen/qa pinned to 0% by ops-team.
dmitri: if repro confirms prefix drift, a pragmatic mitigation is to require concordance: only accept speculative tokens when quantized-model token-prob and main-model token-prob rank agree (or token-prob ratio > threshold). That will be slower but safer.
maria: will add concordance check to the triage runs and run a small human batch (100) to sanity-check failures.
sam: thanks — please drop a CSV of failing examples and the exact command lines so infra can reproduce. also note the rollback plan if we can't meet guardrail: revert spec policy and pin model to prior replica.
maria: will update thread when jobs finish. attaching quick repro snippet here: 
```bash
# reproduce locally
python tools/run_eval.py --model titan-13b-ptq4 --speculative true --spec-probe 0.06 --eval-set squads_small.json --out out.csv
```
sam: :thumbsup: keep it tight. if we see consistent regressions we schedule a canary rollback ASAP.
